articles.title: Solana is shedding its memecoin reputation as big banks move billions into its ecosystem
articles.snippet: Wall Street and payment giants are quietly taking over Solana, moving billions onto the network for tokenized funds and global payments even as the broader crypto market cools down, according to a new report by Messari.

articles.title: Stripe-backed Tempo taps $7.5 billion DeFi lender Morpho to expand beyond payments
articles.snippet: The move brings onchain yield and lending to the payments-focused chain in a bid to offer full-stack onchain finance platform to companies building on it.

articles.title: Ex-OpenAI's Leopold Aschenbrenner bets big on crypto miners for his $13.6 billion AI play
articles.snippet: Aschenbrenner is shorting Nvidia and AMD in favor of bitcoin miners that own the electricity and data centers needed to fuel the next phase of the AI boom.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin gives up all of May's gains, slipping below $77,000
articles.snippet: Strategy made a mammoth $2 billion bitcoin purchase last week, but it's not lifting crypto spirits or prices.

articles.title: Strategy made mammoth $2 billion bitcoin purchase last week
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor and team added 24,869 BTC last week, bringing total holdings to 843,738 coins.
